---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity PCA of CP"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
---

PCA of CP across the 22 target ROIs, separately in preterm- and full-term-born adults (BLS cohort).

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv`
- Outputs (`outputs/figures`):
  - `PCA_scree_CP_<date>.png`: Supplementary Figure S2
  - `PCA_contributions_CP_<date>.png`: Supplementary Figure S3
  - `PCA_scree_CP_FT_<date>.png`, `PCA_contributions_CP_FT_<date>.png`: FT group

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(factoextra)

fig_dir <- here::here("outputs", "figures")
```

```{r}
save_plot_png <- function(plot, filename, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  outfile <- file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0(filename, "_", format(Sys.Date()), ".png")
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(outfile, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  message("Plot saved to: ", outfile)
  return(outfile)
}
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT"))
  )

final_dat_CP <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cd_"), -all_of("id"))

cp_vars <- grep("^cp_", names(final_dat_CP), value = TRUE)

dat_PT <- final_dat_CP %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == "PT")

dat_FT <- final_dat_CP %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == "FT")
```

# PCA in PT (Figures S2, S3)

```{r}
cp_base <- dat_PT %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, dplyr::all_of(cp_vars)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-subject, ~ if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)))

cp_complete <- cp_base %>% tidyr::drop_na()

pca_cp <- prcomp(cp_complete %>% dplyr::select(-subject), scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

summary(pca_cp)

scree_PCA_CP <- fviz_eig(pca_cp, addlabels = TRUE, barfill = "slategray", barcolor = "white") +
  labs(title = "PCA on CP (PT only)",
    subtitle = "Bars: variance per component | Red line: cumulative variance")
save_plot_png(scree_PCA_CP, "PCA_scree_CP")

contr_PCA_CP <- (fviz_pca_var(pca_cp, col.var = "contrib", repel = TRUE))
save_plot_png(contr_PCA_CP, "PCA_contributions_CP")
```

# PCA in FT

```{r}
cp_base_FT <- dat_FT %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, dplyr::all_of(cp_vars)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-subject, ~ if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)))

cp_complete_FT <- cp_base_FT %>% tidyr::drop_na()

pca_cp_FT <- prcomp(cp_complete_FT %>% dplyr::select(-subject), scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

summary(pca_cp_FT)

scree_pca_cp_FT <- fviz_eig(pca_cp_FT, addlabels = TRUE, barfill = "paleturquoise4", barcolor = "white") +
  labs(title = "PCA on CP (FT only)",
    subtitle = "Bars: variance per component | Red line: cumulative variance")
save_plot_png(scree_pca_cp_FT, "PCA_scree_CP_FT")

contr_pca_cp_FT <- (fviz_pca_var(pca_cp_FT, col.var = "contrib", repel = TRUE))
save_plot_png(contr_pca_cp_FT, "PCA_contributions_CP_FT")
```
